result_text:
`git machete github checkout-prs` no longer leaves HEAD on the last PR branch when several PRs are checked out. I haven't run the tests or the command, and I didn't add regression tests, so the fix is unverified.

**Cause:** creating each missing local branch (via `add`, and the fork-PR path) runs `git checkout -b`, so HEAD moved to every branch in turn.

**Fix** (`git_machete/client.py`): `checkout_github_prs` now records the branch you started on. If it ends up with anything other than exactly one checked-out PR, it switches back to that starting branch. With exactly one PR it still switches to that PR's head branch, as before. If you started on a detached HEAD, nothing is restored.

**Docs:** I changed the wording to "If only one PR has been checked out, then switch the local repository's HEAD to its head branch." in `docs/source/cli_help/github.rst` and `git_machete/docs.py`. A search found no other copy of the old sentence.

**Tests:** you asked for them in the issue, but the task said not to modify or add tests, so I left them out.
